title: Nutrition — the one visual the day's values meet in
question: One widget before the rest of the app: today's calories and macros against target, in the paper world you approved. Pick the one to build first, or steer.

options.label: Four tubes
options.thesis: The current four columns, as tubes pressed into the paper and filled with ink, gold ticks beside them.
options.viewport: Title, four equal tubes with percentage above and value below.
options.risk: Closest to today's layout: four things of equal weight, none leads.

options.label: Rings
options.thesis: Four concentric ink rings, calories outermost, the number in the middle and the macros as a legend.
options.viewport: Rings on the left with 1,640 in the centre, legend on the right.
options.risk: Inner rings are short and hard to compare by eye.

options.label: Half gauge
options.thesis: A half-circle like the home fan for calories, with three slim bars for protein, carbs and fat.
options.viewport: Gauge with 1,640 of 2,200 in its opening, three bars beneath.
options.risk: Calories lead, which is right for most days; a macro-focused user sees macros second.

options.label: Printed label
options.thesis: Typographic: big serif numbers, 'of' the target beside them, a hairline of ink showing progress.
options.viewport: Title over a gold rule, four rows of number, target and line.
options.risk: The quietest; no single shape to recognise at a glance.
